summary: A disclosed citation of the Sourcey startup-credits registry was submitted as a top-level comment on a YouTube video whose title is the relevant query itself (How to Get $400,000 in Free Cloud Credits for Startups). The YouTube Data API confirmed the comment as created and public at 2026-10-30T12:01:11Z under comment id UgxSA0cKdAujeq6IBJV4AaABAg; the public comment listing had not yet returned it at 12:12Z, which this evidence reports as pending propagation rather than claiming a verified public render. The comment links both the human page and the digest-pinned JSON release and carries one dated verified offer fact. Host www.youtube.com is admitted by this bounty's contract.
